learning_outcomes.text: Acquires the skill to use the communication skills and behavioral knowledge they have gained in their social and professional lives.
Acquires the skill to be aware of their competencies. Gains Time and Stress Management skills and integrates them into their professional life.
Acquires the awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning and the skill to achieve it.
Acquires the ability to understand and express.

syllabus_topics: Concept of Culture, its Characteristics, and Functions
Key Factors Affecting Healthy Communication, Teamwork and its Importance (Case Study)
Empathic Communication, Body Language, Questioning Techniques (Case Study)
Adjustment Problems and Defense Mechanisms, Anger and Rage Control (Case Study)
assessment_rules: The midterm exam accounts for 40% of the grade and the final exam accounts for 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decisions and specified in the academic calendar.
